base: original CMAB LinTS, three input features, original P1203-derived immediate proxy reward

reference.purpose: Adapter check; the main baseline is still the actual abrCMAB path

memory.hypothesis: H1: isolate data retention while preserving the forced-choice schedule
memory.history_clock: Immediate decision/reward rows, not completed downloads; at most30 prior rows plus current choice

startup.startup_action: highest nominal representation below safe measured throughput
startup.hypothesis: H2: restart treatment changes both forced duration and initial quality; report this as a package

both.history_clock: Immediate decision/reward rows, not completed downloads; at most30 prior rows plus current choice

delayed.feedback: Original P1203 proxy evaluated when the associated request completes, using captured action/context and outcome-time latency/stall history
delayed.training_rows: unique linked completed requests; exact request-object association
delayed.censored: unmatched, error, abandoned or seek-cancelled requests
delayed.qualification: Timing/attribution package changes the observation/update clock; not timing in isolation

outcome.qualification: Download utility and buffer-budget starvation surrogate. Neither actual played QoE nor exact causal stall attribution. Completed segment may later be skipped.

scaled.change: Replace per-refit StandardScaler with fixed physical normalization and explicit intercept
scaled.qualification: Normalization/intercept package; reward and completion clock unchanged

buffer.change: Add buffer/3 clipped0..4 and actual live delay/3 clipped0..8

context.change: RTT is zero-masked if invalid or older than3s; append validity, age/3 and bounded recent RTT difference/200. History is causal, not a handover label.

seeded.change: MAB refit receives seed123456+decision_index; reproducible continuing draw sequence instead of identical restart seed
seeded.qualification: Refit with varying seed, not a persistent fitted estimator

guard.change: Clip LinTS proposal to highest nominal bitrate below measured safe throughput times0.55 when buffer<1s, delay>target+2s or RTT invalid; otherwise0.85

guard_only.change: Choose that throughput/buffer/delay/freshness ceiling directly, with no LinTS call
guard_only.purpose: Isolate whether the guard explains improvement; not a learned controller
guard_only.qualification: Standalone ceiling policy also replaces conservative forced-slot actions; compare the complete bandit/restart package against this heuristic, not a pure learning-only ablation.

unchanged_factors: For the first factorial: three features, LinTS alpha/default seed, reward/timing and system controls. Delayed/outcome changes are separately declared.
initialization: All new validation/final CMAB trials prewarm the same runtime before Load; earlier factorial and feedback runs used cold in-Load initialization and are labelled separately.
